lookupTypes.title: Application type
lookupTypes.description: Storefront vertical (Café, Groceries, Sarees). Saved on products as product_type_id (e.g. app_cafe). Departments and categories are parented on these rows.

lookupTypes.title: Product departments
lookupTypes.description: Menu departments; parent is an application_type row (e.g. app_cafe).

lookupTypes.title: Product categories
lookupTypes.description: Menu categories. Parent is a department or application_type. Code = URL slug for /browse/:categorySlug.

lookupTypes.title: Order fulfillment status
lookupTypes.description: Full order lifecycle (placed → delivered, cancelled, rejected). Vendor forms use in review–rejected only.

lookupTypes.title: Order channel
lookupTypes.description: Café order source: dine_in, qr, aggregator.

lookupTypes.title: Café order status
lookupTypes.description: Kitchen / POS lifecycle statuses for dine-in, QR, and aggregator orders.

lookupTypes.title: Café table sections
lookupTypes.description: Dining areas (indoor, patio, bar) for table management.

lookupTypes.title: Café tables
lookupTypes.description: Dining tables; parent is a café table section. Code = table number at checkout.
